newsitem.title: POLAND: THOMSON BANKWATCH RATES BIG IC-C.
newsitem.headline: THOMSON BANKWATCH RATES BIG IC-C.

text.p: Thomson Bankwatch has rated Poland's Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych SA (BIG) IC-C as an intra-country issuer and LC-1 in the category of short-term domestic-currency debt, the bank said in a statement on Tuesday.
The statement said the rating took into consideration BIG's planned merger with Bank Gdanski .
The LC-1 rating for the bank's short-term zloty liabilities is the best on Thomson's four-grade scale.
BIG's statement said the IC-C rating as an intra-country issuer meant that the bank had a sustainable credit capability.
The intra-country has nine grades measuring credit risk, without involving country risk.
